Prototype 4 encodes N3 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (96%), with EOG (3%) and EMG (2%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+10.3 dB, sensitivity=17.0) and absence of β_h (-0.8 dB, sensitivity=1.8).
The δ activity is present in 97% of each epoch (sustained), with moderate eye movements (SEM 72% active (likely EEG crosstalk)) and atonic muscle tone.
This is coherent with N3 physiology: δ elevated, δ dominant, EMG atonic — all confirmed.
